description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection related to adding and configuring grain call filters in Orleans hosting. It provides deprecated methods for adding filters with replacement guidance, as well as internal methods for registering filters directly. It also includes internal wrapper classes for delegating filter invocation.

classes.name: OutgoingGrainCallFilterWrapper
classes.description: Internal class that implements IOutgoingGrainCallFilter by wrapping a delegate.

classes.name: IncomingGrainCallFilterWrapper
classes.description: Internal class that implements IIncomingGrainCallFilter by wrapping a delegate.

methods.name: AddGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter to the services, deprecated with an exception indicating to use the new method.

methods.name: AddGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a specified filter implementation type as a singleton, deprecated with an exception.

methods.name: AddGrainCallFilter (delegate)
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter via delegate, deprecated with an exception.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Internal method to add an IIncomingGrainCallFilter instance to the service collection.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Internal method to add a custom TImplementation as IIncomingGrainCallFilter.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (delegate)
methods.description: Internal method to add a delegate as IIncomingGrainCallFilter wrapped in a class.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Internal method to add an outgoing grain call filter instance.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Internal method to add a specific outgoing filter implementation.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter (delegate)
methods.description: Internal method to add a delegate as outgoing filter wrapped in a class.
